description:
Seo Juhan, partner attorney at Yulyoung Law Firm. There’s a reason everyone calls him a psycho. 

“I’ve become impotent. Because of you, Attorney Jung.”    
“……Pfft!”      

No normal person would say something like that while casually drinking coffee. 

“Ever since I slept with you, I can’t get it up. If it’s not because of you, then what is it?”    
“Why are you even saying something like that?!”    
“That’s why you have to take responsibility. Let’s get married. As soon as possible.”    
“…You’re insane.”    

Yes, she did make a drunken mistake. She even slept with him first. But suddenly claiming he developed selective erectile dysfunction afterward… made no sense.    

“I’m offering myself to you. Please accept me, my master.”    

And somehow, insanity is contagious.    

“Only I get to touch you, taste you, and have you. You’re mine. No one else. Not even yourself.”   
 
Yet she keeps thinking about him.     

“Spread your legs. I’ll take care of you. I was too rough last time, wasn’t I?”
